definitions.gloss: medley; a sequence combining different parts
definitions.explanation: A combination performed in one continuous stretch: in swimming, a race or relay that mixes the four strokes; in music, a piece stringing several tunes together without pause.

examples.japanese: {妹|いもうと}は{個人|こじん}メドレーが{得意|とくい}だ。
examples.english: My younger sister is good at the individual medley.

examples.japanese: コンサートの{最後|さいご}に、{名曲|めいきょく}を{集|あつ}めたメドレーが{演奏|えんそう}された。
examples.english: At the end of the concert, a medley of famous songs was performed.

notes:
Katakana loanword from English "medley." Used mainly in swimming and music.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {個人|こじん}メドレー: individual medley (one swimmer, four strokes)
- メドレーリレー: medley relay (four swimmers, four strokes)
- ヒットメドレー: a medley of hit songs

In swimming the strokes follow a fixed order; in music メドレー refers to songs played back-to-back without a break.
